leads.title: Workbrew makes open source package manager Homebrew enterprise-friendly
sentences: Providing support and services for popular open source tools is a tried-and-true model — it’s what led IBM to dole out $34 billion for Red Hat, and countless startups have raised venture capital for products that enhance the utility of established community-driven projects.
